task.title: Generating a Splunk bearer token using the Splunk UI
task.shortdesc: To create a Splunk bearer token for Red Hat Quay from the Splunk UI, you can enable token authentication and create a new token.

ul.li: You have installed Splunk and created a username.

step.cmd: On the Splunk UI, navigate to Settings → Tokens.
Ensure that Token Authentication is enabled by clicking Token Settings and selecting Token Authentication if necessary.
Optional: Set the expiration time for your token. This defaults at 30 days.
Enter information for User and Audience.
Optional: Set the Expiration and Not Before information.
Click Create. Your token appears in the Token box. Copy the token immediately.

note.p: If you close out of the box before copying the token, you must create a new token. The token in its entirety is not available after closing the New Token window.
